about: Recurring investor asks: groups of AI shareholder proposals that ask companies for the same kind of thing. scripts/build_proposal_links.py assigns each proposal an ask_id by the ordered rules below (first match on title and subtopic wins). This grouping is this site's reading.

asks.label: Human rights in data center siting
AI tools sold for oil and gas
Data center energy, emissions and costs
Human rights of AI-driven targeted ads
Customer and end-use due diligence (surveillance, military, facial recognition)
Training data and user data in AI
Board oversight and AI transparency reporting

categories.label: AI governance and safety
categories.about: How the board oversees AI, the company's AI principles and transparency, and investments in AI labs.

categories.label: Data center externalities
categories.about: Effects of building and running data centers: climate and energy, water, local communities and human rights where they are sited, and costs passed to others.

categories.label: Harms to people using AI products
categories.about: Effects on the people who use the products: misinformation, child safety, privacy and training data, bias, and AI-driven ads.

categories.label: Harms from how customers use AI
categories.about: Effects of who the AI is sold to and what they do with it: militaries and immigration enforcement, surveillance, oil and gas, and workers.

categories_note: Each proposal is sorted by what it asks about, in four groups set by this site: AI governance and safety; data center externalities; harms to people using AI products; and harms from how customers use AI (militaries, surveillance, oil and gas, workers). No proposal here asks directly about model alignment or catastrophic risk; governance proposals ask about board oversight and transparency.
